title: Thermodynamic scaling and string dynamics in rotating holographic QCD
summary: We investigate the effect of finite angular velocity on the phase structure and Schwinger pair production in a holographic QCD model based on the Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton framework. Rotation is introduced through a boost construction that generates a stationary rotating geometry from the corresponding static background.
